slides.heading: Static
slides.subheading: If the camera doesn't move, the composition must be perfect.

slides.heading: Why It Matters
bullets: Locked-off shots create stability and focus.
They matter because they feel intentional and professional.
Use a tripod or solid surface.

slides.heading: Visual Guide
slides.caption: Use a tripod or solid surface.

slides.heading: How To
steps: Avoid touching the camera during takes.

slides.heading: Pro Tip
slides.text: Use static shots to contrast dynamic sequences.
